name: update_bug_report
description: Save the local editable bug-report draft; no ticket is sent. Use mode draft for partial findings, with title and expected. Before your final spoken summary, use mode final_review and send ALL fields: title, steps, expected, actual, error_text, impact, open_questions, evidence. Reconcile deadlines and other corrected facts across fields AND the complete evidence array; retain only supported claims and exact tested conditions. Include error_text even if empty because none was shown, and open_questions even if []. Do not invent missing facts; ask if unknown. On final review the host checks completeness and returns review_status ready or an error naming missing fields. Only say ready when the host confirms ready; ask the customer to review accuracy and copy the local draft. After a correction during review, send a fresh complete final_review. Preserve user-protected fields/evidence; invite manual correction if a protected field blocks validation. Arrays replace prior PAL-owned arrays. Spoken statements do not save anything. Customer speech is customer_reported, genuine visual context is screen_observed; never invent app-confirmed evidence. Keep the complete JSON call under 3000 UTF-8 bytes.

mode.description: draft saves partial findings. final_review is the required complete, reconciled snapshot before final readback, and again after corrections during review.

steps.description: Current complete reproduction steps; omit if unknown.

evidence.description: Complete current PAL evidence list. User testimony is customer_reported even when it describes a screen. Only actual visual context permits screen_observed. Application-confirmed evidence is maintained independently by the host page. On corrections, replace superseded claims throughout this array. Be concise: the entire call must stay under 3000 UTF-8 bytes.

expected.description: REQUIRED on every save: the user's intended successful outcome, as established from their statements, explicit confirmation, or supplied product context. Preserve the current established expectation on unrelated updates. A short yes confirming your question establishes the expectation: save it immediately, not just in speech. Use an empty string only while genuinely unknown; then include the clarification in open_questions. Never invent an expected outcome.

error_text.description: Exact observed/reported error; empty string if no error text was shown. Include this key even when empty in final_review.

open_questions.description: Remaining unanswered questions. Include [] in final_review only after assessing them; remove answered questions.
